programs.title: Adventure Gold Diggers
programs.desc: The Clermont Diggers come up with a new plan to try and boost their daily gold output. But the radical strategy has deep flaws. The Rookie Miners unearth the biggest nugget of the season at Swiss Diggings. The Mineshaft Hunters are in trouble due to a toxic gas emergency.

programs.title: Aussie Salvage Squad
programs.desc: Safety Bay Beach in Western Australia has been hit by gale force winds and a vessel named Unhinged has been torn from its anchorage and washed ashore. This is the third time it has happened to the unlucky owner. Team Salvage has four hours and 5,000 dollars to re-float the vessel and tow it to a safe new mooring. Job two is a time-critical operation. The team responds to a caravan park in trouble with the law.

programs.title: Mighty Ships
programs.desc: FPSO Maersk Peregrino is the most expensive single project in Maersk history; she is the world's biggest oil production ship and will be permanently hooked up at the Peregrino oilfield off the coast of Rio de Janeiro.

programs.title: Storage Wars
programs.sub_title: Let's Give 'Em Something To Tonka About
programs.desc: It's a long way to Murietta, and Dave is counting on his competition being unwilling to buy a big locker they need to move. Justin finds a partner in the crowd and swings a decent locker.

programs.title: American Pickers
programs.desc: A Kansas junkyard is packed with rusty old cars, signs, machinery, and has an awesome collection inside. Later, in a town that was annihilated by a tornado, jump-start a charity auction.

programs.title: Pawn Stars
programs.desc: Rick heads to New York City to check out an original broadside of the Declaration of Independence. Will he put his John Hancock on the line for this multi-million-dollar piece of history?
